description: What deploys classic cmux (cmux.com and its API) on its own when a commit lands, and which of those paths the classic API guard (scripts/ci/classic_api_guard.py, .github/workflows/classic-api-guard.yml) refuses without a reason. The one list: the guard, its test and the docs (cmuxterm-hq skills/infra/cloud-api-promote, leo-workspace design/cloud.md) read it. Leo, 2026-11-04: "apparently the api if we change it it'll auto deploy so we wanna make extra sure we dont change it for clasisc".

deploys.trigger: Vercel Git integration: web/vercel.json git.deploymentEnabled is {main: true, **: false}; web/tools/vercel-ignore-build.sh skips the build when no web build input changed
deploys.target: Vercel project manaflow/cmux, production cmux.com: the classic app API (/api/vm, /api/runs, /api/account, /api/billing, /api/cron, /v1, the sign-in handler) and the site

deploys.trigger: the same Vercel deploy as vercel-cmux-com
deploys.target: cmux.com pages, docs and messages (no API); listed, not guarded
Vercel docs channel projects (nightly docs); listed, not guarded

deploys.trigger: .github/workflows/iroh-v2.yml: a push to main only dry-runs staging and production; development deploys by workflow_dispatch
deploys.target: Cloudflare Worker iroh-v2 (relay); no auto-deploy, listed, not guarded

deploys.trigger: .github/workflows/cloudflare-relay.yml: a push to main only dry-runs
deploys.target: Cloudflare Durable Object relay (cmux-tui/relays/cloudflare-do); no auto-deploy, listed, not guarded

deploys.trigger: .github/workflows/fleet-artifact-cdn.yml: deploys only by workflow_dispatch on main
deploys.target: CI artifact CDN Worker (internal, no customer API); no auto-deploy, listed, not guarded

next_deploys_not_classic: backend.yml: push to feat-cmux-next deploys cmux-api development and staging (cloud-api-staging.cmux.dev); production only by the promote dispatch. Not on main's tree, so a push to main runs nothing from it.
cmux-vm.yml: feat-cmux-next and feat-cmux-vm-* pushes deploy the NEXT cmux-vm Worker; production by dispatch.
release-rails.yml, cloud-devbox-image-rebake.yml, app-ffi-release.yml: NEXT release rails and images from feat-cmux-next.
backend-migrations.yml: a labelled PR applies NEXT cmux-next Postgres migrations (staging, then production).
